description: The template of one game of ImpAI's bar (tools/impai/bar.py, which fills in the map, the Difficulty, the two players under test and their commanders, and writes the game's own copy): seat 0 an idle human with no unit; seats 1 and 2 the two players under test, each a commander placed at its start position (seat k at StartPos(k + 1), fixed starts, the positions read from the map's .ota), each seat's base storage 1000 metal and 1000 energy (the applier's write after its clear: the clear kills the commanders, which ends a seat's base storage, 0x486518); no alliance; the level's end test off, so the human with no unit cannot end the level; true line of sight and mapping, the skirmish screen's defaults. The harness ends the game when one seat holds no unit (its record's +0x144), or at its cap.
